course.title: Java Programming: From Foundations to Production
course.description: A visual-first Java course that follows the supplied curriculum from the JDK and language fundamentals through object-oriented design, collections, streams, I/O, networking, JDBC, concurrency, testing, security, performance, packaging, and migration.
course.version_scope: Core code examples target Java SE 25 LTS checked 2026-10-11. Java 26/27 release literacy and preview features are separated and marked optional/version-specific. Verify vendor-specific support and API availability before production use.
audience: developers preparing for professional Java applications
prerequisites: Basic computer and file-management skills. No previous programming experience is required; logical reasoning and basic mathematics are helpful but not mandatory.
learning_outcomes: Install and verify a Java Development Kit, compile source files, run programs, and interpret common errors.
Use primitive and reference types, operators, conditions, loops, strings, arrays, methods, and object-oriented design to solve programming tasks.
Apply generics, collections, lambdas, streams, core APIs, exceptions, and resource-management techniques.
Build Java applications that work with files, HTTP services, databases, concurrency utilities, and configurable dependencies.
Test, debug, secure, profile, package, deploy, and maintain Java applications with reproducible evidence.
Distinguish stable Java SE 25 material from release-specific, preview, and specialization topics.

sections_reviewed: B: Complete Java Curriculum (32 modules; lessons 1–336)
E: Advanced and Specialized Java Topics

course.execution_policy: Java code examples require a local JDK or a separately isolated runner. CodeLeaf does not execute Java inside the browser or FastAPI process. Preview examples must use the matching JDK and explicit preview flags.
course.xp_policy_note: Lessons and exercises do not contain XP overrides. The CodeLeaf backend controls 20 base XP and applicable plan boosts server-side.
